newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,456.8 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,456.8 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits rose by 141.9 million Swiss francs to 3,456.8 million in the reporting period ended February 28.
Statement of February 28 in millions of Swiss francs:
Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window totalled 22.7 million francs. There were no Lombard borrowings reported for the prior 10-day period in February.
Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates rose by 34.9 million francs to 1,633.9 million.
An SNB spokesman said there was nothing unusual or noteworthy about the data released today.
